info.title: XCE Cinematic Studio — Gemini Skills Connector
info.description: Official production API connector for XCE cinematic studio plugins (UNIFY, FIRESTARTER, SCRIPT, ENGINE, COMPOSER, MV, CGE, COMMERCIAL_STORYBOARD) powering Gemini and AI Studio.

get.summary: Inspect registered skills and route shorthand commands
get.description: Dispatches XCE shorthand commands (SS, STF, US, SL, FF, 123GO, CMPN) or returns function declarations.

parameters.name: cmd
parameters.description: Universal XCE shorthand command (e.g. SS, SL, 123GO, FF, CGE)

post.summary: Execute an XCE Cinematic Studio tool directly
post.description: Executes one of the 8 XCE plugins with validated arguments.

tool.description: Name of the function declaration (e.g. xce_firestarter_session, xce_engine_cref, xce_mv_director)

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the tool schema

xce_unify_orchestrate.description: Master coordinator for XCE scenes. Audits live schema, verifies source authority (https://xstudio.xrkr80hd.studio), maintains 4-angle UNIFY coverage override for a narrative beat in 16:9, and tracks the world/camera state ledger.

selected_canonical_angle.description: Which of the 4 rendered angles becomes the canonical end state for the next advancing beat (1-4).

direction_box_focus.description: Focus subject or action in Direction Box 1/2.

xce_firestarter_session.description: XCE writers' room engine. Handles creative brainstorming, anti-cliche coaching, SS (Start Story), STF (Story Thus Far), US (Update the Story 6-section handoff: WORLD_TYPE, AESTHETIC_TONE, WORLD_BACKGROUND, STORY_SO_FAR, PRODUCTION_BRIEF, WORLD_RULES_CONTINUITY), and XCE CONTINUE handoff to UNIFY.

new_project_title.description: Title if SS is initializing a new project.

spark_premise.description: Story spark, premise, or pasted narrative text.

xce_script_editor.description: Narrative intent and script beat editor. Enforces character presence rules (only present cast speak), distinct Action 1 / Action 2 definitions, physical start/end states, and duration bounds (3-6s per motion beat).

speaker.description: Character ID or name of speaking subject (must be present in scene).

dialogue.description: Spoken line (raw text without decorative quotes).

start_state.description: Initial physical position and prop state.

xce_engine_cref.description: Exact character reference retrieval (--cref) and asset contract enforcement. Retrieves verified original LOCKED anchor turnaround sheet to serve as the canonical fetch point for all downstream scene generation. Enforces the 6-column 16:9 turnaround sheet contract (front, side, 3/4, rear, front face CU, profile face CU) with 0% drift.

include_media.description: Whether to retrieve base64 image bytes (default: true).

xce_composer_stage.description: Scene generation and spatial staging module. Fetches locked character turnaround sheets as anchor points (--cref) for all cast present, binding their exact physical features, wardrobe, and anchor URLs into 16:9 cinematic scene prompts.

cast_ids.description: Cast present in this scene (used as fetch points to pull locked turnaround sheets).

xce_mv_director.description: Seven-shot director workflow. Manages SL (Shot List), SS (Same Shot frozen moment) vs AS (Advancing Shot sequence), 7-shot progression (establishing wide, alt wide, vertical axis, CU B, reverse CU B, wide profile, detail insert), FF/LF confirmation, and the Y / GEN / N / MOD decision gate.

mode.description: SS = Same Shot (frozen instant), AS = Advancing Shot.

gate_decision.description: Final decision gate: Y/GEN to render all 7, N to standby, MOD to revise.

mod_instructions.description: Revision guidance when MOD is selected.

xce_cge_grade.description: Color Grading Engine (CGE). Previews and stages 16:9 cinematic grades. Factory grades are immutable. Durable saves require explicit PUSH GRADE authorization.

style_name.description: Named cinematic look or LUT description.

confirm_push.description: Must be true for PUSH GRADE to write to XSTUDIO.

xce_commercial_storyboard.description: Commercial video production module. CMPN locks campaign title; 30s (5-6 beats) or 60s (10-12 beats) total runtime. Strict SFX-only sound design track (no dialogue/music). Generates paired first/last frame cinematic video prompts.

sfx_only_notes.description: Practical sound effects only. No dialogue or music.

xce_command_router.description: Universal shorthand command parser for the XCE ecosystem: RPTPLS, STBY, ANSR, LTSTLK, SHFT, NXT/11, 123GO, SS, AS, SL, FF/LF, Y/GEN, N, MOD, STF, US, XCE CONTINUE, BRNSTRM, CMPN, CGE.
